title: Universal closedness and properness are preserved when the target is separated
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that universal closedness, and properness, of a morphism of algebraic stacks are preserved when the target morphism is separated (author lemma at source lines 8652-8672, label lemma-universally-closed-permanence). The proof (source lines 8674-8692) factors the morphism through the fibre product over the base, gets universal closedness of the two factors from the properness of the graph and from base change, concludes by composition permanence and upgrades to properness using the separatedness and finite type permanence statements (proof lines 8674-8691). The factorization and the two permanence steps are the substance. H3.
